arguments.command:
git add docs README.md CONTRIBUTING.md examples/prompt-templates.md && git commit -q -m "docs: reorganize documentation into docs/ and verify claims against code" -m "Split the README into a landing page and focused pages under docs/ (inputs, workflows, models, extensions, prompts, threads, security, how it works), and merge examples/prompt-templates.md into docs/prompts.md. Each page leads with its main point and uses short, active, imperative sentences (ASD-STE100 where it applies).

Corrections found while checking each claim against the code:
- The pit extensions example had a trailing comment on the spec line, which makes the run fail; comments must be on their own lines.
- Sanitization applies to trigger text, /answer replies and question titles only, not to the issue title/body, diff or review comments.
- prompt_template replaces the whole first message, including the commit/push requirements block, and applies only to the first message of a new thread; document {{reviewComments}}.
- pr_number runs on an existing thread are follow-ups, without a new diff.
- A custom trigger_phrase also needs the workflow's if: filter changed.
- prepare-commit-msg hooks skip git commit -m/-F (git passes a commit source); the agent's commit-msg hook rejects 'feat!:'.
- CONTRIBUTING: CI runs npm run check; list the dogfood workflows; tests use pi-ai's faux provider and real scratch git repositories; releases move the v2 tag.

Refs #32" && git add src && git commit -q -m "test: check documentation links, template variables, and extensions examples" -m "The input table moved to docs/inputs.md, so the doc-sync tests read it there. src/docs.test.ts checks that relative links and heading anchors resolve in every Markdown file, that renderTemplate() replaces each variable docs/prompts.md lists, and that each extensions: example parses.

Refs #32" && git log --oneline -3 && git push -q -u origin docs/32-documentation-cleanup 2>&1 | tail -3
